scripts.tauri:dev: npm run build:backend && npx tauri dev
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg . --targets node20-win-x64 --output ../src-tauri/bin/backend-server-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('schema.sql', '../src-tauri/bin/schema.sql'); require('fs').mkdirSync('../src-tauri/bin/uploads', {recursive:true})"
scripts.build:prepare: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:prepare && npx tauri build
